company_name: Zhejiang Futong Quartz New Material Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company manufactures quartz devices essential for various processes in wafer fabrication.
summary: Zhejiang Futong Quartz New Material Co., Ltd specializes in the production of quartz devices used in the diffusion, CVD, etching, and cleaning processes of semiconductor wafer fabrication. Their product offerings include quartz boats, furnace tubes, doors, exhaust pipes, tanks, rings, and other customized quartz products tailored for different semiconductor equipment applications.
capabilities: Quartz furnace tubes for CVD applications
Customized quartz products for etching processes

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and has established partnerships with several well-known domestic equipment manufacturers.
